known_weaknesses.title: Antoine constants
known_weaknesses.body: 0% of materials have Antoine A/B/C. Phase 1 falls back to single-point VP_25 → VP(T) extrapolation is wrong above 40 °C and at the cold-tail.

known_weaknesses.title: UNIFAC γ
known_weaknesses.body: thermo.unifac integration is stubbed. Activity coefficients use a Hansen-distance regular-solution heuristic calibrated only to limonene-in-EtOH.

known_weaknesses.title: OR targets
known_weaknesses.body: 0% of materials have published EC50/Hill coefficients. Receptor occupancy uses a family→OR-affinity prior. Mainland 2014 dataset not yet ingested.

known_weaknesses.title: Hedonic / TRP / IFRA
known_weaknesses.body: Coverage <10%. Ferreira mixture-shift β=0.3 is hard-coded, not fitted.

known_weaknesses.title: Adaptation timescales
known_weaknesses.body: τ_fast / τ_med / τ_slow values from rat single-cell studies. Human bulb-level feedback may differ by 2-3×.

known_weaknesses.title: Maturation kinetics
known_weaknesses.body: Arrhenius A/Ea per reaction class are order-of-magnitude calibrated to one Blakeway 1987 reference. Per-aldehyde overrides not yet supplied.

known_weaknesses.title: Spray atomisation
known_weaknesses.body: Log-normal Dv50=30 µm σ_g=1.5 is the typical perfume-atomiser literature value, not measured for any specific bottle.

known_weaknesses.title: OR polymorphism coverage
known_weaknesses.body: Only OR7D4 / OR5A1 / OR11H7 SNPs encoded. ~400 ORs × 3 variants = ~1200 alleles remain unmodeled.
